Name: TreeFarm
Author: Aufhcegak
Description: 罗宾建造的大型林业基地：大堂中枢电脑管理多个树种林区， 自动种植、自动生长、自动砍伐，产出原版树脂等林业物资。

Downloads.Description:
PC bug-fix update. Fix the lobby computer being missing when entering a newly completed Tree Farm for the first time. Re-entering restores a missing computer. Make the visible computer screen interactive and correctly mark its action as handled. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI. Replace the existing TreeFarm folder; keep your config.json. PC native regression and clean startup passed.

修复林场建成后首次进屋缺电脑，重进可恢复缺失电脑；修复可见屏幕交互和操作返回。硬木产出规则及PC操作保持。

Manifest.Name: TreeFarm 林场
Manifest.Description: 罗宾建造的林场，六种树独立分区，轮伐采脂、统一仓库，每区15至45棵。
Manifest.Author: xiepe
